description: Implementation of the egl::Stream class managing streaming frames, including creation, binding textures, acquiring and releasing frames, and handling D3D11 textures within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: egl::Stream
classes.description: Manages EGL stream lifecycle, texture binding, frame acquisition, and D3D11 texture handling.

methods.name: Stream::Stream
methods.description: Constructor initializing stream with display and attributes.

methods.name: Stream::setLabel
methods.description: Sets the label for the stream.

methods.name: Stream::getProducerFrame
methods.description: Returns the current producer frame number.

methods.name: Stream::getConsumerFrame
methods.description: Returns the current consumer frame number.

methods.name: Stream::createConsumerGLTextureExternal
methods.description: Creates a consumer GL texture external from attributes.

methods.name: Stream::consumerAcquire
methods.description: Acquires a frame for the consumer.

methods.name: Stream::consumerRelease
methods.description: Releases the current frame for the consumer.

methods.name: Stream::isConsumerBoundToContext
methods.description: Checks if the consumer is bound to a specific context.

methods.name: Stream::postD3D11Texture
methods.description: Posts a D3D11 texture to the stream.

methods.name: Stream::releaseTextures
methods.description: Releases all textures associated with the stream.
